newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Merging of Venezuela's Banco Mercantil units OK'd.
newsitem.headline: Merging of Venezuela's Banco Mercantil units OK'd.

text.p: Plans to turn Venezuela's second largest bank Banco Mercantil into a universal bank by combining its various units have been approved by the Venezuelan authorities, bank president Gustavo Maturet said.

Mortgage lending, investment banking and leasing sub-units Banco Hipotecario Mercantil, Banco de Inversion Mercantil, Arrendadora Mercantil and Fondo Mercantil will merge as soon as the new balance sheet is published, Maturet said in a release.
The balance will then be approved by the Banking Superintendency.
Maturet added: "To Mercantil, this process is key to creating products with greater added value, following the strictest rules of banking ethics and risk management techniques."
